tells.1: Bold 'What you'll do' / 'What we're after' labels make it read like a filled-in job-post template.
tells.3: The schedule line is flattened into 'plan a life around the schedule,' a paraphrase that misses the point.
tells.4: Illustrative specifics (180 covers, Luis, whole-animal butchery) are stacked and capped with a sentimental 'we're proud of that.'

reason: Version 2 speaks straight to the cook in a spoken rhythm, without template labels or added color, so it reads most like a skilled person and is the draft I'd publish. Version 3 sands off the sharpest line, and version 4 piles on specifics in a way that feels performed.
